repos_data.description: Free, open source, a high frequency trading and market making backtesting and trading bot, which accounts for limit orders, queue positions, and latencies, utilizing full tick data for trades and order books(Level-2 and Level-3), with real-world crypto trading examples for Binance and Bybit
A fast, embeddable limit-order-book & matching engine in Go — plus a microstructure research harness and a WASM-powered animated explainer. MIT.
